# Grill with Docs

Grilling session that challenges an implementation plan against the domain model.

## When to Use
- Before implementing major architectural features or changes.
- Validating design against established invariants and ADRs.

## When NOT to Use
- Small bug fixes or routine refactors.
- Test-only changes.
